results.name: availabilitySli
results.reason: Exact current 2025-03-01-preview Learn and pinned REST schema were read and matched against every supplied property, required nested field, enum, numeric range, string/ARM-ID type, identity setting, and signal/filter structure. The only published SLI API version is preview; no GA schema exists to migrate to.
results.migration: No GA candidate is published: the Learn version selector and pinned REST tree contain only 2025-03-01-preview. This preview API is the resource used to create the Availability/Latency SLI for the Azure Monitor SLI feature; retain it intentionally until a GA API exists. SLI name inputs are conditional strings and must match the published 3–64 character path pattern when populated; default none inputs suppress deployment.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: Original /name maps to required REST sliName path parameter, with pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_()~-]{2,63}$. Source is the availabilitySliName string parameter supplied by infra/sli/main; parameters default to the none sentinel so canCreateSli is false unless configured. Any configured name must satisfy this exact pattern; no runtime parameter or Azure query was performed.

results.exclusion_reason: Intentional preview retention: Microsoft publishes no GA Microsoft.Monitor/slis version at the pinned specification commit or Learn selector, and these declarations implement the Azure Monitor SLI feature with no published GA resource contract to migrate to. Reassess when a stable API is published.

current.analysis: Fetched exact Learn resource page and pinned preview OpenAPI. SliResource requires description, category, evaluationType, destinationAmwAccounts, baselineProperties, enableAlert, and sliProperties; all supplied. Nested AmwAccount, baseline, Signal, SignalSource, spatial/temporal aggregation, Condition, and UserAssigned identity requirements were checked; enum/range/type values match both declarations. SLI name path pattern is ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_()~-]{2,63}$.

ga.analysis: No GA candidate exists in the public sources checked. The Microsoft Learn version selector shows only Latest and 2025-03-01-preview; the pinned complete REST subtree contains only preview/2025-03-01-preview/openapi.json and the README defines only package-2025-03-01-preview. There is no stable schema against which to compare; the preview API remains necessary for the Azure Monitor SLI resources.

breaking.analysis: The Learn change log labels 2025-03-01-preview as the oldest version tracked; it provides no earlier change comparison. No GA version exists, so GA breaking changes cannot be assessed. Current preview schema constraints and values are fully checked above; no absent history is represented as “no breaking changes”.
